text:
anya: Quick sync — we need a concise roadmap for regional routing presets (latency/residency/isolation) so sales can promise migrations Hosted->Dedicated->Private.

sam: Can we treat them as orthogonal axes rather than bundles? region_affinity / residency_lane / isolation_level.

mohit: Agree. Implementation: policy 3-tuple and a small compiler to resolve routes deterministically.

rachel: Customers want one toggle. We should expose opinionated presets that map to 3-tuples (e.g., low-latency, eu-compliant, tenant-isolated).

julia: UI request: Console preview showing selected preset => routes + estimated cost delta + fallbacks. Sales demo requirement.

anya: Launch checks for a preset: perf baseline across 2 regions, cross-region failover latency <2s, canary 48h @5%, model-variant coverage matrix, KMS/audit checklist.

sam: Add criterion: model availability matrix — if variant not present, compiler must refuse or mark degraded policy.

mohit: Draft policy proto: `policy={preset:"eu-residency",allowed_regions:["eu-central-1"],isolation:"hard",fallbacks:["same-region-quant","cross-region-compatible"]}`. Resolve by health>latency>cost.

rachel: Legal/ops: retention for audit logs (some ask >=2y). Need KMS/HSM integration steps documented.

julia: Recommend starting beta with US-WEST + EU-CENTRAL to keep scope small.

deploy-bot: canary deploy policy-compiler/v0 to staging at 3123459000 :rocket:

anya: Next actions: mohit -> compiler PR + synthetic tests (EOW), rachel -> playbook + legal checklist (Wed), sam -> model matrix (2w), julia -> console preview wireframes (10d). If no objections by EOD I'll fold into roadmap.
